name: CHE Avče
zag_role: Third party quality control of the materials used to construct the dam and other structures, and monitoring during and after construction
description: Third party quality control of the materials used to construct the dam and other structures, and monitoring during and after construction.

specifications.label: Dam type
specifications.value: two earth embankments (upper reservoir) with asphalt lining

specifications.label: Turbines
specifications.value: 1 reversible Francis pump-turbine, variable speed (DFIM), 600 rpm nominal

specifications.label: Waterways
specifications.value: headrace tunnel 697 m (D 3.90 m), penstock 1,567 m, powerhouse shaft 80 m deep, 18 m ID

specifications.label: Monitoring
specifications.value: construction QC only (continuous compaction control, GPS), operational monitoring not described

specifications.label: Penstock diameter
specifications.quote: premer cevovoda zmanjšuje od 3,3 m do 2,6 m.

specifications.label: Penstock, above ground section
specifications.quote: Nadzemni del cevovoda v dolžini 862 m je vpet v šest

specifications.label: Penstock, vertical shaft
specifications.quote: v vertikalni jašek globine 190 m in premera 3,1 m.

specifications.label: Penstock, horizontal pressure tunnel
specifications.quote: v horizontalnem tlačnem tunelu dolžine 395 m in premera 3,1 m

specifications.label: Penstock, inclined pressure tunnel
specifications.quote: kot poševni tlačni tunel dolžine 120 m in premera 2,6 m.

specifications.label: Headrace tunnel lining
specifications.value: reinforced concrete over the whole length
specifications.quote: je na celotni dolžini obdan z armirano betonsko oblogo

specifications.label: Surge tank, lower chamber
specifications.quote: spodnja komora dolžine 117 m in premera 3,5 m

specifications.label: Surge tank, shaft
specifications.quote: jašek višine 41 m in premera 4,5 m

specifications.label: Surge tank, upper chamber
specifications.quote: zgornja komora dolžine 40 m in dimenzijami v prerezu 4,5 m x 4,5 m.

specifications.label: Upper reservoir asphalt lining, slopes
specifications.value: two layers of 8 cm (bearing and sealing)
specifications.quote: po 8 cm debeline nosilne plasti in zaporne plasti na poševnini

specifications.label: Upper reservoir asphalt lining, floor
specifications.quote: po 7 cm debeline vsakega sloja na horizontalnem delu bazena.

specifications.label: Lower reservoir
specifications.value: existing Ajba reservoir on the Soča, free volume 416,000 m³
specifications.quote: prost volumen akumulacije, ki znaša 416.000 m³.

specifications.label: Motor generator rating
specifications.quote: SENG decided to install a 195 MVA reversible variable-speed unit.

specifications.label: Grid transformer
specifications.quote: mrežni transformator z močjo 200 MVA

specifications.label: Turbine mode operating range
specifications.quote: 25 to 40 m³/s

specifications.label: Cycle efficiency
specifications.quote: The efficiency of the process is 77%.

specifications.label: Designer
specifications.quote: IBE d.d.

specifications.label: Contractor
specifications.value: Primorje Ajdovščina (main building contractor), in consortium Primorje and SCT
specifications.quote: The main building contractor was Primorje Ajdovščina.

specifications.label: Equipment supplier
specifications.value: consortium Melco, Rudis, Sumitomo (Mitsubishi Electric Corporation)
specifications.quote: Konzorcij Consortium Melco - Rudis - Sumitomo

specifications.label: Cost
specifications.quote: The cost of the Avče pumped storage plant was €122 million.

source_differences: Upper-reservoir embankment heights: correction note says 23 m and 17 m (SENG), but the SENG 'Perspektive energije' publication gives two earth embankments 10 m and 15 m high (NW and SW sides). Different height definitions possible, flag.
Capacity: 185 MW turbine / 180 MW pump (SENG, power-technology, en.wikipedia) vs GEM 180 MW.
Annual generation: SENG publication 426 GWh vs ELES Naš stik 280 GWh.
Commercial operation: en.wikipedia April 2010, power-technology 2009, SENG: trial-operation permit Dec 2009.
Record 'crosses: Soča' is not apt for a pumped-storage plant.
